newsitem.title: UK: Schroders gains as BZW rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: Schroders gains as BZW rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in British investment bank Schroders Plc rose on Wednesday as analysts at BZW issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
Schroders was up 69p, or 4.2 percent, at 17.04 stg by 0946 GMT in thin volume of 101,426 shares. The stock rattled back in recent sessions from its record 17.90 stg set on May 19.
Market sources said BZW had highlighted Schroders record of growing shareholder value and was positive on its strategy of building an integrated investment bank.
However, analysts at BZW were not immediately available for comment.
